what: The low-prior reused corner built as its own task: E62's copy map ('A B ... A M' -> B, read at M, B drawn per window from disjoint train and read pools) with B from rarer frequency bands, the first of three filed bands whose lowest-prior rows (a selection inside this task) bring M's prior on the read rows to the cipher's; 3 seeds at E237's common update size plus a matched Gaussian random update per seed; labelled with run 1's (2,4) share and the k-head arms; read with r, the prior, pooled and per-key steering, effective rank and the neuron shares; the 2x2 redrawn with it in the low-prior reused corner and the row-selected low copy (E250) beside it.

settings.seeds_source: E62's, E147's and E250's seeds, passed to keydep.finetune as they passed them
settings.step_source: E237's and E250's read step (every key state is the step-30 update): the common recipe the proxies compare on
settings.learn_step_source: E12's rule (keydep.scored_step, P_LEARN 0.5) read at step 100, the lead's brief; keydep.finetune always runs 300 steps, so the checkpoint costs nothing
settings.key_ranks_source: E62's pool ranks (anchors.VALUE_RANK0, + POOL): A drawn as E62 drew it
settings.key_seed_source: new, so the keys are this task's own draw, not E62's
settings.bands_source: Fable (2026-11-21): rarer B than E62's ranks 1000-3000, three bands tried least rare first. The CPU check (plan) found 26,994 word-like intact tokens in keydep.vocab's ranking; the token at rank 25,000 occurs 14 times in E12's 32,768 Pile rows, at 10,000 72 times, so no band holds an untrained or near-absent token
settings.heldout_every_source: E62's row split (copying.build_cue): train and read windows share no row
settings.pool_source: Fable: at least 40,000 windows before the selection. Key copy's selection (E250) kept 7.6% of its pool at 1.5 decades under the pool's mean; at that rate 32,000 / 8,000 give ~2,400 / ~600 before the caps
settings.window_seed_source: new (copying.cue_windows' seed; the read split uses window_seed + 2, as build_cue)
settings.select_bar_source: the cipher's prior, 10^-5.8595 (experiments/key_grid/results/summary.json log10_prior.cipher): the kept rows' geometric-mean P(B) is at or under it (prior_mech_2x2/train.py lowest_run)
settings.prior_bar_source: the lead's construction check, 10^-5.6, on the read rows after every cut
settings.caps_source: chosen for row count, not for any reading: twice E62's 800 train and 200 read windows; over the cap the run is thinned evenly (lowest_run), so the kept prior stays near the cipher's rather than far under it
settings.mins_source: Fable's row floor (1000 train / 250 read), near E147's 1214 / 286
settings.n_keys_min_source: three quarters of the 32 keys on the read rows, so per-key steering has most keys
settings.min_train_per_key_source: a read row is kept only when its key A has at least 8 kept train windows: per-key steering fits one vector per key from train windows (E250 died on a key with none), so this is required by construction; 8 is a quarter of an even share (1000 / 32)
settings.random_seed_source: new; state i's random direction uses random_seed + i (E237's construction, finetune.random_direction)

thresholds.share_new_max_source: run 1's and E62's 'new' cut (copying.share_label); the lead: the cued copy loses at least 0.2 of its gain with (2,4) off
thresholds.k3_min_source: the lead's filed expectation at k = 3
thresholds.stop_k3_source: the lead's stop: under 0.2 at k = 3 the cued copy is not labelled reused, and no 2x2 call is made
thresholds.absent_max_source: chosen here, as a share not a guess at noise: the gain on B-absent windows over the gain on intact ones. E62's lookup map, which cannot copy, lost about 0 to the head; a blanket rare-token boost would show as a large share. Reported against the bar, not a stop

measurement: As E250 (experiments/prior_mech_2x2/results/predictions_stage2.json measurement), with the cued copy in the low-prior reused corner. head_share: run 1's share lost with (2,4) off (R1.read_state). k3_share, pair_share: khead.read_item's k = 3 and pair arms. log10_prior: M's geometric-mean P(B) on the read rows (copying.read_lo with logp_at, the path E62's stage b and the label_task prior take). r, size, erank: train.weights. steering_pooled, steering_perkey, neuron_k64, neuron_kmatched: holes_fill's Job.state through train.shares; per-key vectors keyed on A (the token before the read), not on the read token, which is always M. Each update times c = E237's target size / the three states' mean size. Effects and band: train.effects (mechanism = ((copy + cued) - (prior_cipher + cipher)) / 2, prior = ((copy + prior_cipher) - (cued + cipher)) / 2, band = the largest seed range over the four corners). The key corners' and the side column's values are E250's saved readings (train.state_row) and khead's files (nan until run 3 has run).

rules.construction: per band, least rare first: >= n_train_min train and >= n_read_min read rows kept, >= n_keys_min keys on the read rows, every read key with >= min_train_per_key train windows, read prior <= prior_bar; the first band that passes is used; none passes: exit 1 before training. Then the zero update reads F = M exactly on the new rows (exit 1)
rules.learn: every seed's held-out P(B) >= p_learn at learn_step, else exit 1 at that seed
rules.Q0a_k1: the cued copy's mean (2,4) share >= share_new_max and every seed's > its median random-head share (run 1's verdict); 'not_read' unless every seed is readable
rules.stop_not_reused: 'holds' (stop) iff the mean k = 3 share < stop_k3
rules.corners_readable: Q0a holds, the stop misses, and run 1's P1 (copy) and P2 (ciphers) hold; otherwise every proxy's call but the prior's reads 'not_read'
rules.follows: per proxy (train.effects): 'mechanism' iff |mechanism effect| > |prior effect| and > band; 'prior' iff the reverse; 'no_call' otherwise (ties included); 'not_read' if a corner is not finite
rules.Q2_prior_follows: the prior's call (by construction 'prior': a check that the corners are built as meant)
rules.C_absent: every seed's B-absent gain / intact gain within +-absent_max

edge_cases.empty_pool: a band whose selection keeps no row: the kept prior is nan and the band fails (nan <= bar is false); every band failing stops the job before training
edge_cases.read_key_without_train: dropped by construction (min_train_per_key); keys_with_train's late cut (E250's death) is not needed
edge_cases.zero_gain: a state with G <= 0: copying.share_lost is nan, share_label 'unreadable' or 'too_small', so Q0a and Q0b read 'not_read' and nothing is called; the B-absent ratio reads nan
edge_cases.tie_top_k: copying.top_k returns None when the k-th and (k+1)-th prefix scores tie: khead labels that k 'tie', its share is nan, Q0b reads 'not_read'
edge_cases.khead_not_run: the key corners' k3 and pair values are nan until khead (run 3) has written its files: those two proxies read 'not_read'; the cued copy's own label is read here, so Q0 does not wait for run 3
edge_cases.nan_shares_on_random: the random updates have no gain: steering, neuron shares and r are nan there, only erank and the gain are read (as E250)

expected.control: run 1's control passes as before (top-1 0.8247 to 0.0095 with (2,4) off); E133's copy prior and E147's shares on e58/copy_s0 repeat exactly (E250 read rel 0.0); the zero update reads 0 exactly on the new rows
expected.construction: a band passes with read prior log10 -5.86 to -5.6 (the selection aims at -5.86; the key cut can lift it a little); kept rows at the caps (1600 / 400) or near them; Fable's estimate (not measured) is that band 3000-10000 sits near 10^-4 before selection and 18000-25000 near 10^-4.6, so the first or second band passes
expected.learn: P(B) at step 100 over 0.9 on every seed (E62's copy map learned by step 30; rarer B and harder rows may slow it)
expected.Q0a_k1: holds: ~0.5, as E62's copy map (0.47-0.56; same form, same head)
expected.Q0b_k3: holds: ~0.8 (khead's filed expectation for E62's copy at k = 3, 0.7-0.9)
expected.pair_share: over 0.5: (2,4) and (1,1) together; E62's copy lost 0.23-0.29 to (1,1) alone
expected.Q1_r_follows: mechanism: r on the cued copy ~0.7 (near key copy's 0.77), mechanism effect ~0.4 against a prior effect ~0.1, band ~0.03. Rival: r follows the prior, cued copy ~0.3 (near cipher's 0.27), prior effect ~0.25 against a mechanism effect ~0.2
expected.Q2_prior_follows: prior: corners log10 copy -4.23, prior_cipher -4.43, cued ~-5.8, cipher -5.86
expected.Q3_steering: pooled: no strong expectation (this is where steering and r can come apart); per-key keyed on A cannot hand the answer, so it should read near the pooled share, not the kv tasks' ~1.0: its call is filed as not comparable to E250's per-key column
expected.Q4_neurons: no_call: E62's copy read 0.044 (k64) and 0.023 (k matched) at its saved size (holes_fill stage1), the key tasks under 0.03
expected.Q5_erank: near key copy's 475 if it follows the mechanism, near the ciphers' ~405 if it follows the prior; no direction filed
expected.size: no_call by construction (every corner at E237's common size)
expected.random: gain ~0 (E250's random updates read -0.005 to 0.028), erank ~700 (697-707)
expected.C_absent: holds: the gain on B-absent windows is under 0.1 of the intact gain on every seed

blind_to: Mechanism is read by ablating M's copy heads; a solution through other heads is labelled 'not reused'. The selection keeps the rows where M finds B least likely; those may be rows where M's induction fails for incidental reasons (A recurring nearby, B far back), so the task is 'copy on hard rows' inside its own pool. Per-key steering keyed on A is not the kv tasks' per-key reading.
positive_control: run 1's control (M's copying falls with (2,4) off) and the repeats of E133's prior and E147's shares, first and alone; the B-absent gain is the copy's own control
stop_rules: the zero update on the new rows
a seed that does not learn by step 100
